Today’s
Report

 
Enjoy top to bottom skiing and riding with 20 trails now open. 8 trails are groomed with 3 lifts deeming you access. 11″ of fresh snow fueled the slopes this past week. The Graduate Lift 7 is open providing a ride to the base area from the Columbine and Gelande parking lots. We have a 20″ base right now. More snow is expected and snowmaking efforts continue this early season that will open up even more of the mountain soon!

Join us for our Thanksgiving Buffet today. Make your reservations or get your lift tickets 24/7 online at store.purgatory.ski.


ATTENTION: As we continue to expand our open terrain, please be aware that early season conditions exist. Regardless of a trail being marked as green, all open terrain should be considered intermediate+ with variable early-season conditions.

Power Pass Resorts

  • Arizona Snowbowl
    Flagstaff, AZ
    Featuring the all-new Arizona Gondola, unforgettable views of the Grand Canyon & beyond, and the southwest’s largest beginner terrain.
  • Brian Head Resort
    Brian Head, UT
    With the Greatest Snow on Earth® & red rock views, Brian Head delivers over 360” of snow every year & Utah’s highest base elevation.
  • La Parva
    Santiago, CHILE
    Nestled in the heart of the Andes Mountains, at an altitude of 2,750 meters and interconnected with Valle Nevado, La Parva offers world-class terrain and over 200,000 acres of heli-skiing.
  • Lee Canyon
    Las Vegas, NV
    Located less than an hour from the Strip, Lee Canyon offers 445 acres of lift-served and hike-to terrain.
  • Nordic Valley Ski Resort
    Eden, UT
    Located in the Wasatch Mountains just north of Salt Lake City, Nordic Valley is known for its ski school programs and rapidly-expanding terrain.
  • Pajarito Mountain Ski Resort
    Los Alamos, NM
    Touting an impeccable fall line and unique history, Pajarito offers incredible bump runs, bountiful views & no lift lines.
  • Purgatory Resort
    Durango, CO
    Located in the rugged San Juan Mountains in southwest Colorado, this destination resort offers steep tree skiing & wide-open cruisers.
  • Sandia Peak Ski Area
    Sandia Park, NM
    Located in the heart of the Sandia Mountains and just 45 minutes from Albuquerque, Sandia Peak delivers diverse terrain across 35 trails with 1,700 feet of vertical.
  • Sipapu Ski and Summer Resort
    Taos County, NM
    Known as the first ski area to open in the state every year, Sipapu offers a distinct family-friendly vibe and the best tree skiing around.
  • Spider Mountain Bike Park
    Burnet, TX
    The nation’s first and only year-round, lift-served bike park, Spider Mountain is located on the banks of Lake Buchanan.
  • Valle Nevado
    Santiago, CHILE
    Located in the Andes mountain range just 37 miles from Santiago, Chile, Valle Nevado is the largest ski area in the Americas and boasts the region's highest quality of snow.
  • Willamette Pass Resort
    Crescent Lake, OR
    With its legendary steeps and the first 6-person high speed detachable chairlift, Willamette Pass receives an average of over 430” of snowfall.
